chars.HAMID: HAMID: a young man wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie, dark blue jeans and white sneakers.
chars.IMANE: IMANE: a young woman wearing a light pink hijab, a long white knitted cardigan over a lilac dress.
chars.SISTER: SISTER: a stylish young woman wearing a bright red leather jacket, black skinny jeans, big gold hoop earrings and dark sunglasses pushed up on her head.
chars.MOTHER: MOTHER: a middle-aged woman wearing a dark green djellaba and a beige headscarf.
chars.MANAGER: MANAGER: a middle-aged man with round glasses wearing a grey suit and a dark red tie.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: A Moroccan engagement evening in a traditional living room with ornate cushions and a tray of mint tea. HAMID and IMANE sit side by side, IMANE shyly smiling at him, while behind them SISTER leans in the doorway staring at HAMID with a cheeky raised eyebrow; HAMID glances back at her nervously, sweating. Awkward comic tension.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Night in a small modern apartment in Fes. HAMID lies on a sofa holding his phone above his face on a video call, grinning and blushing, a cup of tea on the table, city lights through the window.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: A Moroccan family kitchen. MOTHER proudly pats HAMID on the shoulder with a big smug smile while HAMID shows her his phone and laughs happily.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: An open-plan accounting office. HAMID sits at his desk excitedly writing a leave request on his computer, a calendar on the wall beside him with days circled, a pile of folders on the desk.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: A manager's office. MANAGER smiles and shakes HAMID's hand across the desk, approving his request; HAMID looks relieved and excited.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: HAMID works hard late at his desk in the empty office, stacks of folders, a desk lamp, determined face, typing fast.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: A sunny street in Al Hoceima with white and blue houses and the Mediterranean sea in the distance. HAMID arrives carrying a travel bag and IMANE waves happily at him.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: A busy Moroccan souk with wedding dresses and fabrics hanging on the stalls. IMANE walks beside SISTER, who struts forward confidently and flashes a flirty smile straight at HAMID; HAMID stops in his tracks, shocked, mouth open, holding shopping bags. IMANE does not notice.
